title: billing.einvoice.accepted.v1
description: The e-invoice portal registered a B2B invoice and issued its reference (FIN-011, EinvoiceService.accept; India: the IRP issued the IRN); subject = the invoice. Ids, the regime and the portal's reference only: never the payload, a buyer or an amount. Consumer core.reporting: log-only handler until it exists.

documentId.description: The invoice the e-invoice is for.

externalId.description: The portal's reference: the IRN for IN_IRP.

version.description: Outbox id of this event: monotonic per aggregate.
